user.title: Sign in to Apple
user.description: Your password is used only for this sign-in and is not saved. This integration uses an unofficial Apple service that can stop working without notice.

two_factor_method.title: Choose verification method
two_factor_method.description: Choose where Apple should send the verification code.

two_factor_code.title: Enter verification code
two_factor_code.description: Enter the six-digit code from Apple.

accessory.title: Import AirTag keys
accessory.description: Upload the FindMy.py JSON export (or decrypted plist) for this AirTag. The file contains sensitive tracking keys; keep it private.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Apple again
reauth_confirm.description: The Apple session for {email} expired. Enter the password to reconnect; it will not be saved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Apple. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: Apple rejected the email or password.
error.invalid_accessory: This is not a valid FindMy.py AirTag JSON or decrypted plist file.

abort.already_configured: This Apple account is already configured.
abort.flow_expired: The setup session expired. Start again.
abort.no_2fa_method: Apple did not offer a supported verification method.

init.title: AirTag Tracker options
init.description: The integration polls less often while the AirTag is in any Home Assistant zone and more often while it is outside all zones. Faster polling increases Apple account lockout risk.
